scripts.dev: concurrently "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client

scripts.start: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node server/src/index.js
